reasons.business: No monetisation design; crowded habit-RPG / anime-System niche where the real app lock is the only differentiator; no evidence from anyone but the owner, whose own run is self-reported as weak (progress.md:27). Capped at 6 without real-user evidence in any case.
reasons.pmf: No external users, interviews or retention data. Scope (3 Systems, Gates, Dungeons, levels, stats) exceeds the trial's one question. The Focus E core quest is self-contradictory and honour-only (system_catalogue.dart:166-170).
reasons.technical: Pure-Dart rules engine with one config file, serialised writes, append-only log, trusted time, DST-safe across 9 extra zones (VERIFIED-RUN). Format and analyze clean; 260/260 Dart and 19/19 Kotlin tests; 82.8% line coverage; release artefacts match HEAD, targetSdk 36, 16 KB aligned. Held back by: the travel-west wrongful verdict and dead zone (probe A), a day with no quest counted as cleared (probe B2), an untested platform layer (notifier 0%, game_store 36%, main.dart none), unverified Android 15/16 background starts, and very large UI files.
reasons.uiux: Distinctive, coherent System visual language; reduced motion and large text handled; 48 dp hold targets. Problems: 7-step onboarding with 16 must-read rule lines, alarm-red 00:00:00 in a safe state, hold buttons without a semantic action in release (hud_kit.dart:259-266), block screen with no route to the emergency exit, two competing progressions, store screenshots with a personal status bar and third-party names.
reasons.security: No INTERNET permission and no backup (VERIFIED-RUN on the merged manifest); only the launcher activity exported; secrets out of git; live privacy policy that matches the code; prominent disclosure before usage access. Abuse against another person is mitigated by the always-available emergency exit and the never-lock list. Minor: free text in user-initiated exports.
reasons.behavioural: Safe penalty design: no exercise punishment, nothing scales, doubles or carries over, sleep protected, dry run, near miss, reduction valve, contest, exit. Undercut by punishment-centred framing, shaming report copy (report.dart:255-267), near-miss copy that contradicts the streak rule, a first milestone 21 or more days away, and the travel-west wrongful verdict.
reasons.retention: Loss-based loop with no early reward; heavy permission and terms friction; the predictable response to an early failure is uninstalling to avoid the lock; no retention measurement or data.
reasons.publication: AAB, policy, disclosure and 16 KB alignment ready. Not yet submitted or done: Data safety, Health apps, FGS specialUse declaration and video, clean screenshots. The 12-tester, 14-day closed test is not started. Android 15/16 device behaviour unverified. P1 wrongful-verdict defect open.

findings.title: Travel west: day judged hours before local midnight, then a dead zone where progress is refused
findings.fix: On a zone change during the open day, judge at the later of old-zone and new-zone midnight (capped, e.g. +6 h), or auto-excuse the day (no penalty, no XP, logged); show the new deadline in the UI.
findings.acceptance: Probe A under TZ=America/Los_Angeles with an Asia/Kolkata-issued game: no quest_failed before local midnight (or a logged excusal), and setProgress is accepted all local day; existing DST tests still pass.

findings.title: No real-user evidence; the personal-account closed test (12 testers, 14 days) has not started
findings.fix: Recruit 15-20 testers, ship the Focus-only build (DOD_FOCUS_ONLY), collect log exports on days 7, 14 and 30, and compute D7/D30 retention and clear rate.
findings.acceptance: 12 or more testers opted in for 14 or more continuous days; retention and clear-rate table produced from exports.

findings.title: Blocker background starts and block-screen layout unverified on Android 15/16; specialUse FGS declaration and video not submitted
findings.fix: Device matrix (Android 13, 14, 15, 16 plus one aggressive OEM; with and without the battery exemption) across reboot, midnight wake, lock start and force stop. Make the battery exemption mandatory if alarm starts fail. Apply WindowInsets in BlockActivity. Record and submit the FGS declaration video.
findings.acceptance: Signed checklist with pass/fail per device; the lock appears within 2 s at lock start after a reboot; FGS declaration submitted.

findings.title: Scope buries the trial question: 3 Systems, Gates, Dungeons, levels and stats; 7-step onboarding with 16 rule lines
findings.fix: Focus-only build; hide levels and stats; replace the 21-of-30 Gate with an early milestone (5 cleared days); cut the terms to 6 or fewer lines with an 'All rules' link.
findings.acceptance: Onboarding of 5 or fewer steps; terms of 6 or fewer lines; a single progression on the quest screen.

findings.title: A start day with no quest is logged as quest_cleared, inflating the report clear rate and showing a QUEST CLEARED notice
findings.fix: An empty quest produces no verdict (a QuestNotIssued event); the report and streaks skip it.
findings.acceptance: Probe B2: cleared=0 and no notice for the start day.

findings.title: Hold-to-confirm buttons have no semantic action in release builds
findings.fix: Add Semantics onLongPress, or a confirm dialog when accessibleNavigation is on.
findings.acceptance: A TalkBack or switch-access user can confirm a quest item.

findings.title: An unmeasured screen-time cap fails the day with no warning when usage access is missing
findings.fix: 21:00 notification and a System Check badge when today's cap is unmeasured; point to the honour confirmation or the permission.
findings.acceptance: Planner test schedules the warning when the cap is unmeasured and the meter is unavailable.

findings.title: Shaming verdict copy in the 30-day report
findings.fix: Neutral, terse facts plus one next action; no moral judgement.
findings.acceptance: Copy review: no lines attributing intent or blame.

findings.title: Near-miss notice says 'The streak resets' but the streak skips near-miss days
findings.fix: Align the copy with the streak-neutral logic and pin it with a test.
findings.acceptance: A widget test shows the streak unchanged after a near miss and notice text that matches.

findings.title: Block screen has no route to the in-app emergency exit; inset handling risk under Android 16 edge-to-edge
findings.fix: Add an 'OPEN DO OR DIE' button; pad with system-bar insets.
findings.acceptance: Device screenshot with 3-button navigation: both buttons fully visible; the tap opens the Penalty tab.

findings.title: Focus E quest ('No phone after waking') needs phone use to prove no phone use, and is honour-only
findings.fix: Replace it with a scheduled phone-free block enforced by the watcher, or a measured cap.
findings.acceptance: Catalogue test; the Focus E item is measured or enforced.

findings.title: Store screenshots show a personal status bar, third-party app names and the Personality System instead of Focus
findings.fix: Retake clean, Focus-first screenshots with neutral app names.
findings.acceptance: 4 new screenshots without personal notifications or third-party marks.

findings.title: IP proximity: 'Penalty Zone', daily push-up quest, Gates and Dungeons, E-S ranks and blue System windows evoke one franchise
findings.fix: Rename 'Penalty Zone'; never reference the franchise in marketing; seek advice if it is to be monetised.
findings.acceptance: Renamed in the UI and listing.

findings.title: Platform layer barely tested (notifier 0%, PrefsGameStore 36%, blocker bridge 30%, main.dart none); no integration tests
findings.fix: MethodChannel-mock tests, a PrefsGameStore round-trip test, and an integration_test for the start path.
findings.acceptance: Each of these files at 70% or more line coverage.

findings.title: Release kit describes exact alarms as 'deadline warnings' only; they also wake the lock watcher
findings.fix: State both uses in any declaration.

findings.title: Penalty tab shows an alarm-red 00:00:00 when no penalty is in effect
findings.fix: Calm empty state without the countdown.
findings.acceptance: Widget test of the no-penalty state.

findings.title: abandon() before 18:00 on an unfinished live day skips that day's verdict
findings.fix: Document it, or refuse abandon on any live unfinished day after the quest was issued.
findings.acceptance: Probe B returns false, or the rule is stated in the terms.

findings.title: Whole game plus unbounded log re-encoded to one SharedPreferences string on every change; linear log scans
findings.fix: Move to SQLite, or rotate the log after 90 days; index honour and excuse flags.
findings.acceptance: Save time under 50 ms with a 1-year synthetic log.
